name: Mexico presidential election
evidence_note: not pre-registered: settings chosen on the 2018 count only (configs/mx2024_dev_2018.toml), but configs/mx2024_v1.toml was first committed after scoring, and one exploratory run on the 2024 count (tau = 0.015, 30-minute ticks) was looked at before the config was frozen; outcome long known
summary: Polymarket was already 90% sure of Sheinbaum two days before the vote, so the count offered no trade; at 25% counted the section model was 1.5 points below her final share (raw count 2.9), but its 90% intervals held the final share in only 10% of minutes.
